subject: Next steps: purchase path & trial success criteria (CloudMesh)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Anika Bose <anika@cloudmesh.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: purchase path & trial success criteria (CloudMesh)

Hi Anika —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on procurement and how the trial converts to paid: 

1) Procurement route: you mentioned procurement prefers a PO-based purchase for anything >$50k ARR but procurement is happy to accept credit card for pilot spend under $5k. Could you confirm the dollar threshold and whether your marketplace (CloudMall) would be used instead?

2) Trial design & success metrics (proposed):
   - Trial window: 30 days starting when production traffic routed to Redwood (we can set a firm start date).
   - Usage threshold for automatic billing kickoff: 10k gen-tokens/day sustained for 7 consecutive days OR customer signoff on success criteria.
   - Key success metrics: p95 latency < 350ms for 512-token gen; top-5 intent accuracy > 85% on your test prompts; 70%+ NLU coverage for target flows.

3) Contract & timeline:
   - We can provision a short-term SOW + MSA (draft attached) and accept a PO. Laura from Legal will help on redlines.
   - If you go marketplace, billing and SSO will be simpler but it can add a 2–3 week listing lead time.

4) Action items:
   - Anika: confirm procurement preference (PO vs card vs marketplace) and put procurement contact on copy (Ravi?).
   - Marcus: prepare a trial kickoff checklist (provisioning, telemetry dashboard, eval prompts).
   - Monica: schedule an onboarding session during week 1 of trial to calibrate evals.
   - Laura: hold for any legal asks once Anika confirms PO route.

If PO is the path, can you share the PO intake form and expected approval lead time? I’ll loop in Legal and Ops to accelerate.

Thanks — speak soon.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood-MSA-draft.pdf (MSA + short SOW template)
From: Anika Bose <anika@cloudmesh.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@cloudmesh.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: purchase path & trial success criteria (CloudMesh)

Thanks, Mina — good summary and appreciated. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement route: for pilot projects we typically approve up to $7,500 on card. Anything above that needs a PO and a 2-step approval (engineering manager + procurement). For production we prefer PO.
- Marketplace: we are evaluating CloudMall listing but for speed we’d likely do direct PO for this pilot. Marketplace would add 2–4 weeks.
- Timeline: procurement lead time for a PO (assuming standard MSA) is ~10 business days. If there are redlines we’ll need more time.

I’m looping Ravi (procurement) here — Ravi, can you confirm the PO intake process and share the standard PO template? Also flag any necessary insurance or SOC evidence.

On metrics — the thresholds look fine. On the billing trigger—we’d prefer explicit signoff rather than automatic billing; can we agree that reaching the usage threshold will prompt a billing discussion and not immediate charge?

Happy to start the trial the week of 3/22 if we can finalize the SOW and PO details before then.

Thanks,
Anika Bose
Head of AI Platforms
CloudMesh
anika@cloudmesh.io

(Quoted reply below)
> On Fri, Mar 12, 2027 at 09:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on procurement and how the trial converts to paid:
> > ...
From: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@cloudmesh.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Anika Bose <anika@cloudmesh.io>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: purchase path & trial success criteria (CloudMesh)

Hi all — Ravi from Procurement. Attaching our PO intake form and basic vendor checklist. Quick notes: 

- PO timeline: we can turn a PO in 7–10 business days if we receive a signed MSA and completed vendor questionnaire.
- Evidence needed: SOC 2 Type II report OR equivalent security questionnaire answers, proof of cyber liability insurance ($1M), and a data processing addendum for customer data (if any).
- Marketplace vs PO: marketplace listings are fine but procurement still requires the vendor to complete our security checklist.

Attachment: CloudMesh_PO_Form.pdf (fillable)

Please route the MSAs and security docs to vendor-ops@cloudmesh.com so we can fast-track.

Thanks,
Ravi Shah
Procurement Manager
CloudMesh
ravi.shah@cloudmesh.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Anika Bose <anika@cloudmesh.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: purchase path & trial success criteria (CloudMesh)

Anika / Ravi — thanks for the fast replies. Quick internals and next steps from our side: 

- We’ll treat this as a PO-first pilot with a card fallback for any initial provisioning costs under $7.5k.
- Monica will run the onboarding session during week 1 of the trial and set up the Redwood Console dashboard with the specific eval prompts you shared.
- Mina & I will finalize the trial kickoff checklist; proposed firm start date: Mon 2027-03-22 if legal and procurement can complete the MSA & PO by 2027-03-19 EOD.
- Billing trigger: Per Anika request, usage threshold (10k gen-tokens/day for 7 days) will raise a billing discussion. We will not auto-charge without explicit PO or signed purchase confirmation.

Laura — I’m dropping the MSA draft in your queue (attached) — please advise on any redlines to accelerate procurement.

Action items: 
  - Mina: finalize SOW (one-pager) and send to vendor-ops@cloudmesh.com + Anika.
  - Monica: draft onboarding agenda and monitoring dashboard links.
  - Laura: review MSA and call out must-have redlines.

Looking forward — happy to adjust if procurement has other constraints.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
